{{Top|leg}}

A '''robo-dumpster''' was an automated, unmanned vehicle used mainly in [[City/Legends|urban]] areas to perform refuse collection operations. Depending on the model's [[Cyber pilot system]], internal guidance mechanism and [[Computer/Legends|computer]] capacity, they could be pre-programmed to perform their primary tasks without Human supervision. In some cases, they were remotely controlled through radio-transmitted instructions to the vehicles computer. As with all computer-automated vehicles, the robo-dumpster was monitored by [[Traffic Central]].
